2609.02233.title: InfraPatch: Cross-Task Targeted Grayscale Patch Attacks on Infrared-Adapted Vision-Language Models
2609.02233.paper_summary: Infrared vision-language models (IR-VLMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for multimodal perception under low-visibility conditions, yet their robustness to targeted adversarial attacks remains poorly understood. Existing adversarial patch methods mainly study RGB-based models or a single downstream task and do not characterize whether localized perturbations can induce an intended semantic target in IR-VLMs. We propose InfraPatch, a white-box, per-instance framework for targeted digital grayscale patch attacks against IR-VLMs. InfraPatch optimizes a compact single-channel patch within an approximately 5% local-area budget, combines proxy-guided placement with task-adaptive semantic objectives, and induces target behaviors in image classification, image captioning, and binary visual question answering. We evaluate ten infrared-adapted model variants on 300 synthetic infrared-style images generated by applying DiffV2IR to a fixed 30-category COCO subset, using clean-conditioned targeted success criteria. InfraPatch achieves targeted attack success rates from 86.00% to 100% across the ten variants. On CLIP and BLIP-2, proxy location search improves success by 6.67 and 10.33 percentage points over optimized random placement, respectively; LLaVA-1.5 remains saturated near 100% under both settings. Patch-area and objective ablations further expose substantial differences in vulnerability across architectures and task formats. These results show that small grayscale patches can inject chosen target semantics across IR-VLM families under a controlled digital threat model, motivating stronger robustness evaluation for infrared multimodal systems.
2609.02233.paper_summary_zh: 紅外視覺-語言模型（IR-VLMs）已成為低能見度條件下多模態感知的一個有前景的範式，但它們對針對性對抗攻擊的穩健性仍然不甚了解。現有的對抗性補丁方法主要研究基於RGB的模型或單一下游任務，並未描述局部擾動是否能在IR-VLMs中引發預期的語義目標。我們提出了InfraPatch，一種針對IR-VLMs的白盒、每個實例的目標數位灰階補丁攻擊框架。InfraPatch在約5%的局部區域預算內優化一個緊湊的單通道補丁，結合代理引導的放置與任務自適應的語義目標，並在圖像分類、圖像標題生成和二元視覺問答中引發目標行為。我們在300張通過將DiffV2IR應用於固定的30類COCO子集生成的合成紅外風格圖像上評估了十個適應紅外的模型變體，使用乾淨條件的目標成功標準。InfraPatch在十個變體中實現了86.00%到100%的目標攻擊成功率。在CLIP和BLIP-2上，代理位置搜索分別比優化的隨機放置提高了6.67和10.33個百分點的成功率；LLaVA-1.5在這兩種設置下仍然接近100%飽和。補丁面積和目標的消融進一步揭示了不同架構和任務格式之間的脆弱性顯著差異。這些結果顯示，小型灰階補丁可以在受控的數位威脅模型下，注入選定的目標語義到IR-VLM家族中，促使對紅外多模態系統進行更強的穩健性評估。
